_meta.description: Circuit elevation above mean sea level, used to correct the flat ISA air-density constant in configs/physics.yaml for altitude. Keyed the same way as tyremind.data.f1_loader.CIRCUIT_ALIASES so the two tables stay in sync.
_meta.source: Public geographic record (circuit surveys, race-preview altitude explainers). Elevation varies by tens of metres across the length of some circuits (Spa most notably, ~400-500m); the single figure here is the start/finish line, which is what matters for the pressure a session was actually run at.
